reason: The cited lines show the tool validates a user-supplied path, reads a host directory with fs.readdir, stats entries with fs.stat, and returns file/directory names and size metadata. That supports SECRET because non-public host filesystem metadata is brought into the agent context. It does not show arbitrary code execution, and it does not send data to an attacker-readable destination or otherwise write/post externally. Although returned filenames could in some environments be attacker-controlled, these lines alone do not establish attacker control over the directory contents, so UNTRUSTED is insufficient.
